name: OpenTable
oneLiner: Restaurant reservation network and table management system owned by Booking Holdings, now adding AI features for diners (Concierge) and restaurants.
bestFor: Full-service and fine-dining restaurants and groups that take reservations and want access to OpenTable's diner network plus table, guest and marketing tools.

updates.text: Launched Concierge, a generative AI assistant on restaurant profiles that answers diners' questions before they book.
Expanded Concierge into a broader AI dining assistant with natural-language restaurant search.

Released its largest product suite to date (20+ new or updated features): AI-generated restaurant profiles, Guest AI recommendations, voice AI partner integrations, and listings in Google, ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity and Alexa+. US and Canada first, other markets in Q4 2026.

features: Reservation network and booking widget for the restaurant's own website
Guest profiles with visit history and preferences
Automated confirmations, reminders and email marketing (higher plans)
Concierge AI that answers diner questions on the restaurant profile
AI-generated restaurant profiles from the restaurant's website and operator input
Bookings distributed through AI assistants and search (Google, ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, Alexa+)
Integrations with voice AI phone agents and POS systems such as Square

pricing.text: OpenTable sells tiered plans (Basic, Core, Pro) with monthly subscriptions and per-cover fees for network bookings. Current amounts could not be verified on opentable.com; third-party 2026 summaries list $149, $299 and $499 per month.

notes: Owned by Booking Holdings. Concierge launch confirmed for July 2025. Dropped from original review: '60% of restaurant bookings happen outside business hours' (unsourced) and 'powered by Perplexity and OpenAI' (not confirmed in this research). Third-party sources report a 2% fee on prepaid reservations, no-show charges and deposits from January 2026 (unverified on opentable.com, not used). Other 2026 items seen but not verified with a primary source: OpenTable Media advertising product (Feb 2026), acquisition of Canadian reservation platform Libro (Apr 20 2026, listed on OpenTable's IR site https://opentablepr.gcs-web.com/). Piano Piano case study is OpenTable marketing (12% year-over-year cover and sales lift, undated). HMSHost partnership is older. Company-reported figures in the August 2026 release (AI-referred diners spend 20% more; 500,000+ monthly Concierge users) are vendor claims.
